## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Equity leadership (SPY (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND) confirms underlying risk appetite while several regime ratios flagged NEUTRAL, yielding no clear directional tilt.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit metrics mixed: HYG (1W: +0.01% | 1M: +1.52%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +0.28%) CORRECTION — net NEUTRAL for credit. Volatility lower: VXX (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -21.04%) BELOW TREND, while long-duration bonds TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND points to modest upward pressure on yields.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Slightly tighter bias: UUP (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND suggest marginally firmer conditions, but overall ratios remain neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND; Financials steady: XLF (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +7.62%) ABOVE TREND; Communications lagging: XLC (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION — style: Growth/momentum showing strength but with selective pockets of rotation.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperformance but global participation: SPY (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND while EM EEM (1W: +2.63% | 1M: +12.68%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND show broad engagement, though FXI lags relative to EM.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation present but cooling: IWM (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +12.08%) ABOVE TREND supports small-cap participation, while IBIT (1W: -1.66% | 1M: +12.75%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +12.21%) CORRECTION indicate short-term profit-taking in high-beta/theme exposures.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Oil-led strength: USO (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +15.59%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.06% | 1M: +12.54%) ABOVE TREND; Copper CPER (1W: -1.16% | 1M: +6.10%) CORRECTION and Gold GLD (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND show mixed signals across commodity complex.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy rally with name-level catch-up: XLE (1W: +4.69% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY alongside strong crude BNO (1W: +11.06% | 1M: +12.54%) ABOVE TREND — watch whether sector earnings/flows follow spot strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Large-cap and Tech leadership (SPY and QQQ ABOVE TREND) provides a clear tailwind. DIVERGENCE: several thematic/speculative ETFs (IBIT, ARKK, CPER) in CORRECTION represent minor-to-moderate dispersions to watch.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to tech/large-cap momentum via XLK/QQQ while monitoring energy exposure and speculative themes; reduce exposure to long-duration bonds and gold (TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND; GLD (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND and Financials XLF (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +7.62%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: Communication XLC (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION and Materials XLB/DBB (DBB showing 1M:+5.79% but 1W:-1.23% CORRECTION) if weakness persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Crude BNO (1W: +11.06% | 1M: +12.54%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +15.59%) ABOVE TREND on continued supply/geo headlines. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND and Copper CPER (1W: -1.16% | 1M: +6.10%) CORRECTION if growth sentiment fades.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value leadership inflection); SPY near recent breakout zone (monitor 1M momentum).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive with large-cap and tech leadership, but regime ratios remain mixed. XLK/QQQ showing strength while thematic/speculative ETFs (IBIT, ARKK) are in CORRECTION — monitor those divergences and oil-driven energy flows.
